findings.review: Coherent open wooden case with three corked amber bottles, linen bandage, metal instrument and horseshoe; warm wood and neutral iron remain distinct on light/dark backgrounds, no visible text/red cross. The bandage and horseshoe supply the strongest small-size cues.
findings.limits: Conceptual kit; museum medicine chest reference is not an identified military veterinary kit. Fine compartment details disappear at 32 px.

findings.review: Woven cylindrical soil-filled gabion and a visibly connected spade form one readable warm-material silhouette. Entire shovel grip is inside the original image (visible bounds top 7 px), additional canvas supplied without clipping or altering it. No modern wire cage, landscape or castle.
findings.limits: An illustrative symbol for military earthworks, not a measured reconstruction. Wicker detail merges at small size; gabion outline and shovel remain.

findings.review: Two harnessed horses, ammunition limber and straight cannon on a connected wooden trail. Four visible vehicle wheels, continuous barrel and leg/hoof silhouettes reviewed. Brown horses, warm wood, restrained bronze and neutral iron; real transparent exterior and major internal gaps.
findings.limits: Reduced symbolic pair, not a full historical gun team; complex harness details are not mechanically certified. Horses dominate at 32 px and the rear gun is clearer at 48/64 px. No in-engine validation.
